units.source_text: 尽管如此，金阁的美从没有中断过的时候！

en.t: Even so, the beauty of the Golden Pavilion had never once been interrupted!

units.source_text: 它的美总是在某处回响。

en.t: Its beauty was always echoing somewhere.

units.source_text: 我有如息耳鸣疾的人，到处听见金阁的美的回响，习以为常了。

en.t: Like someone suffering from tinnitus, I had grown used to hearing the echo of the Golden Pavilion's beauty everywhere.

units.source_text: 以声音来做比喻的话，这座建筑物犹如历经五个多世纪响声不绝的小金铃或小琴。

en.t: If one were to compare it to sound, this building was like a little golden bell or a small harp that had kept ringing for more than five centuries.
If their sound were to cease...
